title: P67 OpenCode evaluation adapter
mission: Build a concrete privacy-bounded OpenCode V2 external-agent adapter for P67 Gen2, with AgentSwitchboard owning provider execution/evidence transport and Triage P67 retaining scientific grading authority.
safeParallelWork: PR #309 routing-request builder; no shared implementation files
forbiddenScope: Triage frozen Gen1/Gen2 prompt identities or treatment wording
provider credential values or automated provider login
effectiveness claims from static, synthetic, or smoke proof
expectedArtifacts: OpenCode capability/readiness contract and status probe
neutral structural event normalizer and local instrumentation plugin

tasks.title: Version neutral capture and evaluator-owned annotations
acceptanceCriteria: adapter cannot assert evaluator-only usefulness/first-green/fixed-point judgments
P67 derives evaluative labels from neutral workspace/validation/contract evidence
Gen1/Gen2 frozen prompt identities remain unchanged
privacy and invalid-run semantics remain fail-closed

tasks.title: Implement OpenCode capability and provider-readiness probe
acceptanceCriteria: required noninteractive structured execution, explicit provider/model, isolated config and instrumentation capabilities are verified not guessed
provider/model/agent identity is explicit
credentials are never emitted
missing capability/auth/quota returns one typed blocker
evidence: tooling/evals/p67-opencode-adapter/capability-contract.v1.json - versioned capability/readiness contract
tooling/evals/p67-opencode-adapter/Get-P67OpenCodeAdapterStatus.ps1 - read-only probe script
tooling/evals/p67-opencode-adapter/fixtures/ - synthetic readiness fixtures (ready, blocked-not-found, blocked-identity, evaluative-rejected)
tests/test_p67_opencode_adapter.py - Python contract tests
scripts/Test-P67OpenCodeAdapter.ps1 - PowerShell contract tests
probe verifies 5 required capabilities: noninteractive_execution, explicit_identity, isolated_config, instrumentation_feasibility, auth_readiness
blocker codes aligned with Triage adapter-contract.v2.json vocabulary (RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE)
read-only probe: no global config mutation, no credential storage, no raw prompt/response persistence

typed blockers implemented: OPENCODE_NOT_FOUND, OPENCODE_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE, OPENCODE_IDENTITY_OPAQUE, OPENCODE_CONFIG_IMMUTABLE, OPENCODE_NONINTERACTIVE_UNSUPPORTED, OPENCODE_INSTRUMENTATION_IMPOSSIBLE
status schema forbids credential fields: api_key, token, secret, password, credential
test coverage: happy path (ready fixture), typed blocker paths, evaluative field rejection
proof ceiling: capability verification only, does not prove adapter implementation or provider effectiveness

tasks.title: Build canonical OpenCode P67 adapter
acceptanceCriteria: shell-free P67 argv invocation works without manual prompt copying
one privacy-bounded result JSON is produced
raw provider text/stdout/stderr is not persisted
workspace/process/time bounds are enforced
one machine-local config holds pair identity constant
evidence: tooling/evals/p67-opencode-adapter/New-P67AdapterConfig.ps1 - machine-local config generator; emits compute-authority-agent-adapter/v1 schema; names/paths/provider/model/limits only; never stores credential values

tooling/evals/p67-opencode-adapter/Invoke-P67OpenCodeAdapter.ps1 - canonical P67 argv target; accepts only workspace/task/prompt/result placeholders; enforces workspace/timeout/privacy bounds; emits compute-authority-provider-capture/v2 schema; fails closed on timeout/nonzero/missing; enforces CAPTURE_EVALUATIVE_REJECTED

tooling/evals/p67-opencode-adapter/ConvertTo-NeutralCapture.psm1 - neutral event normalizer PowerShell module; maps provider events to capture v2 allowed fields; rejects evaluative/privacy/credential fields; validates capture contract compliance

tests/test_p67_opencode_adapter.py - extended with 12 ADP-02 tests covering: component existence, config no-credential-values, invoke argv-only, invoke privacy-bounded, invoke fail-closed, invoke evaluative-rejected, normalizer structure, normalizer evaluative/privacy/credential rejection, capture v2 schema
scripts/Test-P67OpenCodeAdapter.ps1 - extended with ADP-02 contract tests for New-P67AdapterConfig.ps1, Invoke-P67OpenCodeAdapter.ps1, and ConvertTo-NeutralCapture.psm1
Python tests: 23 tests total (21 passed, 2 skipped due to pwsh unavailable in test environment); all ADP-02 tests passed
argv-only invocation: no shell composition (Invoke-Expression, iex forbidden)
privacy boundary: no raw_transcript, full_conversation, model_text persistence
fail-closed: timeout/nonzero/missing-result return INVALID status with exit 1
evaluative rejection: CAPTURE_EVALUATIVE_REJECTED enforced for useful, first_green, after_fixed_point, correct, effectiveness
credential safety: no api_key, token, secret, password, credential values in tracked files or config output
capture contract v2: compute-authority-provider-capture/v2 schema; neutral structural telemetry only
proof ceiling: IMPLEMENTATION + STATIC/SYNTHETIC VALIDATION (ADP-02 complete); live OpenCode smoke (ADP-04) and effectiveness remain unproven

tasks.title: Prove synthetic cross-repo interoperability
acceptanceCriteria: action/validation/subagent/parallel/timeout/nonzero/missing/malformed paths covered
P67 accepts neutral results and rejects forbidden/self-rated capture
no hidden-gold/raw-text leakage
repository validators and patch hygiene pass
evidence: tooling/evals/p67-opencode-adapter/fixtures/adp03/ - 8 synthetic fixtures covering all required paths: happy-path VALID, validation-nonzero, timeout fail-closed, missing-result fail-closed, parallel/subagent lane, privacy rejection, evaluative rejection, invalid workspace

scripts/Invoke-P67OpenCodeAdapterSyntheticInterop.ps1 - durable synthetic interoperability runner; exercises config → invoke → normalize → capture v2 paths with machine-readable receipt (schema: asb-p67-adp03-synthetic-interop-receipt/v1)
tests/test_p67_opencode_adapter.py - extended with 13 ADP-03 Python tests covering fixture validation, contract compliance, synthetic-only constraint, and receipt generation
scripts/Test-P67OpenCodeAdapter.ps1 - extended with ADP-03 contract tests covering fixtures, runner execution, receipt schema, and 8-path coverage verification

synthetic fixtures validated: all contain compute-authority-provider-capture/v2 schema; VALID fixtures include workspace_state and validation_result; INVALID fixtures include invalid_reason with typed codes

privacy/evaluative rejection: fixtures demonstrate fail-closed behavior; no actual forbidden fields outside rejection markers; normalizer module validates against ForbiddenEvaluativeFields, ForbiddenPrivacyFields, ForbiddenCredentialFields

8 required paths covered: (1) happy-path VALID with validation_passed=true, (2) validation_passed=false with exit_code=1, (3) EXECUTION_TIMEOUT with 600s elapsed, (4) RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE for missing result, (5) parallel/subagent synthetic lane with provider_actions_count>1, (6) CAPTURE_PRIVACY_REJECTED, (7) CAPTURE_EVALUATIVE_REJECTED, (8) WORKSPACE_INVALID fail-closed

receipt schema: asb-p67-adp03-synthetic-interop-receipt/v1 with test_run_summary (total/passed/failed/success), execution_summary, test_results array, proof_level=SYNTHETIC_INTEROPERABILITY, adp03_paths_covered array
runner execution: pwsh scripts/Invoke-P67OpenCodeAdapterSyntheticInterop.ps1 -OutputPath <path>; validates all 8 fixtures + normalizer module; emits machine-readable receipt; exits 0 on success
proof ceiling: SYNTHETIC INTEROPERABILITY only; no live OpenCode provider execution; live smoke remains ADP-04
